Stealth: Avoid being spotted by enemies.

Not all enemies will pursue you, but when they do they must first succeed a Spot check against you. Stealth increases your chance to avoid detection. Carrying a lit Torch also makes you much more visible.

While Stealthy, you will move slower than usual, so if you are spotted you may have to unstealth in order to escape.

潜行：避免被敌人发现。

并非所有敌人都会追击你，但当它们追击时，必须先通过对你的察觉检定。潜行能提高你不被发现的机会。手持点燃的火把也会让你显眼得多。

潜行时你的移动速度会比平时慢，因此一旦被盯上，你可能需要退出潜行才能逃脱。

lv0#20059/m_Text
Each Trait has a progress bar.

When you complete the progress you learn something about that creature, either a weakness or strength. Each Species Trait (as opposed to a Body or Type trait) will move you closer to unlocking the Trait.

Once you unlocked all of the Species Traits for that monster, the locked Trait will become available for purchase with Trait Points.

每种特质都有一条进度条。

完成进度后，你会了解到该生物的一些特点，或是一个弱点，或是一项优势。每个物种特质（相对于身体特质或类型特质而言）都会让你更接近解锁该特质。

一旦你解锁了那只怪物的全部物种特质，被锁定的特质就可以用特质点购买了。

This section describes various combat interactions.







本节介绍各种战斗交互机制。
Select a Character for Spell Training
选择一名角色进行法术训练

Keep Watch:

Assigning a character to the Keep Watch slot allows you to spot enemies that may  get close to camp, before they are close enough to engage in combat.

Being prepared for an enemy reduces the chance that you will be ambushed.

The Watcher will still heal, but not as fast as those who are asleep.

守夜：

指派一名角色负责守夜，可以让你在敌人接近营地、还未近到能交战时先行发现它们。

对敌人有所防备，可以降低你遭到伏击的几率。

守夜者仍会恢复，但速度不如熟睡的人。

Arcane Marks:

Arcane marks can only be seen when gazing into the arcane realm, such as with your Arcane Sight spell. Each one has a specific meaning, and once understood, can be used to identify what kind of magical things is linked to the area you are looking at.

Arcane Marks are not meant to be interacted with directly, and do not change based on other conditions.


(to avoid Spoilers, this section in a work in progress)

奥术标记：

只有凝视奥术领域时（例如施展「奥术视觉」法术），才能看见奥术标记。每个标记都有特定含义，一旦理解，就能用来辨别你所观察的区域与何种魔法之物相连。

奥术标记不应被直接互动，也不会因其他条件而变化。


（为避免剧透，本节仍在撰写中）

Music:

Assigning a character to the Music slot allows you to give your party bonuses and to heal slightly faster. The bonus can be split between many stats and attributes, but is applied randomly to each character.

The strength of the bonus is increased by your Music skill and the length of your rest.

The Music Player will still heal, but not as fast as those who are asleep.

音乐：

指派一名角色进入音乐位，可以为全队提供加成，并让恢复速度稍快。加成可以分配在许多属性与能力上，但会随机作用于每个角色。

加成的强度取决于你的音乐技能与休息时长。

乐手仍会恢复，但速度不如熟睡的人。

Initiative:
At the beginning of combat, each character and monster makes an initiative roll. The highest initiative takes the first turn, and so on.

First, a random roll from -5 to +5 is added to your base Initiative. 

The formation of the party can alter your initiative between -3 and +3.
Initiative is not re-rolled until the next combat.

先攻：
战斗开始时，每个角色与怪物都要进行一次先攻检定。先攻值最高者最先行动，依此类推。

你的基础先攻值会先加上一个 -5 到 +5 的随机值。 

队伍阵型可使你的先攻在 -3 到 +3 之间变化。
先攻在下一场战斗前不会重新掷骰。

First Aid:

Assigning a character to the First Aid slot allows them to use their First Aid skill to heal the other characters faster.

This slot is best used with a character that is not injured or has less to gain than the others.

The First Aider will still heal, but not as fast as those who are asleep.

急救：

指派一名角色进入急救位，可让其运用急救技能，更快地为其他角色疗伤。

这个位置最适合安排在未受伤、或受惠最小的角色身上。

急救者仍会恢复，但速度不如熟睡的人。

Armor is direct Damage Reduction. Every point of Armor reduces damage taken by 1, but some attacks can avoid Armor.





护甲：

Runes:

Runes are a collection of symbols, etched in stone. These symbols consist of a central element, the most noticable part of the rune, that represents what kind of thing the rune is tied to. This can be a moon, or an individual, or perhaps even something else. 

There are also secondary markings that indicate additional requirements for the rune to activate.

(to avoid Spoilers, this section is a work in progress)

符文：

符文是一组刻在石头上的符号。这些符号由一个核心元素（符文最显著的部分）构成，代表符文所系之物，可能是一轮月亮、一个人，甚至别的东西。 

此外还有次级标记，用来表示符文激活所需的额外条件。

（为避免剧透，本节仍在撰写中）

He claimed to be searching for his lost magic, which he had been tricked into sealing away in a tomb. No one is quite sure where he came from, but he continued his ravings up until his death. According to him, the magic could only be found by saying his name at the right location, under an archway. The graveyard is not very large, and one would think that he surely would have found the location were such a thing true. Interestingly, the name Atticus is itself a surname in the land of Ameyria, though it is pronounced Addicus.
他自称在寻找自己遗失的魔法，那魔法是被人设计封印在一座墓穴中的。没人说得清他来自何方，但他一直到死都在胡言乱语。据他说，只有在正确的地点、拱门之下，念出他的名字，才能找到那魔法。墓地并不大，若真有此事，照理说他早该找到那个地点了。有趣的是，Atticus 这个名字本身是阿梅利亚之地的一个姓氏，只是读作 Addicus。

It is over. When we withdrew our citizens one last time, and entered this grand central hall two cycles ago I was sure that we would never leave. But Zakerunda and his company came through! Sadly, none of them have returned, but I can feel the presence of evil withdrawing from the borders of the protective barrier. The emissaries of darkness are slithering back into the deep crevices they came from. We will see the light of day again! Blessed be the lineage of all those who sacrificed to end this reign of terror. I propose we name our new city Emerisk, for light and hope has come into the world again.

结束了。两轮之前，当我们最后一次撤回市民、
走进这座宏伟的中枢大厅时，
我还确信我们再也出不去了。
但扎克伦达和他的同伴们成功了！遗憾的是，
他们无一归来。但我能感觉到，
邪恶正在从防护屏障的边界退去。
黑暗的使者正爬回它们来时的深渊裂隙。
我们将重见天日！愿所有为终结这场恐怖统治
而牺牲的血脉都蒙受祝福。
我提议把我们的新城市命名为埃梅里斯克，
因为光明与希望已重回世间。

If you have found this note, then all is not well. I begin my journey to find the ancient safehouse known as Kalindruar. With me, I take Razeed, Quay, Jesper and my daughter. Few others remember details more than a day old. Whatever is taking hold of us will not stop.

I believe the shelter will protect us from further degradation, if we can find it. I once thought that there was a way through the library or Renault family crypt, but we were prevented by dark creatures. Instead, we must venture into the caves. Razeed will carry the Codex.

If we did not make it, then perhaps these keys will allow you one last opportunity. May the Unknown be with you.

如果你找到了这张便笺，说明情况不妙。
我启程去寻找那座名为卡林德劳尔的古老避难所。
随行的有拉齐德、奎伊、杰斯帕和我的女儿。
其他人大多已经不记得一天以前的事。
无论是什么在侵蚀我们，它都不会停下。

我相信，只要能找到那座避难所，
它就能保护我们不再继续退化。
我曾以为可以穿过图书馆或雷诺家族的墓室，
但黑暗生物挡住了去路。我们只得改走洞穴。
典籍由拉齐德携带。

如果我们没能成功，
那么这些钥匙或许能给你最后一次机会。
愿「未知」与你同在。

To my son Hawthen, heir to the Renault family fortune, I leave this word of wisdom. Ever since an alliance was forged in the 'north' between Renault and Gyffard, our families have stood as 'pillars' of leadership. Emerisk needs us, if it is to survive. Remember the ancient word of our fathers, "@4". May it guide you, and our people, to Shelter.

致我的儿子霍森，雷诺家族财富的继承人，
我留下这句箴言。
自从雷诺与吉法德在「北方」结盟以来，
我们的家族一直作为领导力的「支柱」屹立不倒。
埃梅里斯克若要存续，离不开我们。
记住我们先祖的古老箴言：「@4」。
愿它指引你，也指引我们的人民，前往庇护所。

Razeed and I decided to try separate passages. I think it was a mistake, but he is wiser than I. All that matters is that the book is kept safe.

Already, I feel myself slipping away... even if we can find the passage to Kalindraur, there's no telling whether anyone will be left there to help us.

拉齐德和我决定分头探索不同的通道。
我觉得这是个错误，但他比我更有智慧。
只要书能安然无恙，其他都不重要。

我已经感觉到自己正在渐渐消散……
即便我们找到了通往卡林德劳尔的通道，
也说不准那里还有没有人能帮上我们。

This land of massive fungus has been our refuge for ten long cycles, and I am certain that all the others who fled are lost to us forever. We have long worked alongside the Scaphin here to share this place, even before our city fell. In truth, it belongs to them more than us, but we are refugees now. How I long to see the sun again, and would gladly leave this place. They are kind enough, but something stirs among them. I worry that they tire of us. And there is more. The mushrooms are... different, leaning slightly towards us, as if they wish to say something, though I cannot say what. Perhaps it is in my head, but I think it bodes ill. Between this and the Scaphin, I doubt we will need the dark lord to finish what he began.

这片巨菌之地已经庇护了我们整整十轮，我确信，
其他所有逃散的人都已永远与我们失散。
早在城市陷落之前，
我们就一直与这里的斯卡芬共同生活、共享此地。
说实话，这里与其说属于我们，不如说属于它们，
但我们现在是难民。我多么渴望再见一次太阳，
愿意就此离开这里。它们待我们足够友善，
但它们之中有些东西在骚动。
我担心它们已经厌倦了我们。还有一事。
那些蘑菇……不太一样，它们稍稍朝我们倾斜，
仿佛想说些什么，我却说不出是什么。
也许只是我的错觉，但我认为这是不祥之兆。
有这些异状和斯卡芬，
我们恐怕等不到黑暗领主来亲手了结我们了。

It was easy, really. A simple visit to the library, a little bit of deduction, a dash of reason and bold action... To be truthful, this village is too small for me. If one studies well and applies logic there is little that cannot be accomplished. There is nothing that will halt my progress now. I am destined for greater things!

其实很简单。去一趟图书馆，稍加推断，
再加上一点逻辑与果断的行动……说实话，
这座村子对我来说太小了。只要勤加钻研、
运用逻辑，就没有什么事办不成。
如今再没有什么能阻挡我前进。
我注定要成就更伟大的事业！

I have only this paper left after leaving my journal. A name carries on the air. Baumonus. I know this name from my studies, but it was a myth... no matter. Baumonus reaches out, corrupting the manatite here, and I with it. I shall try to close the rift if I can. Perhaps, if I could detonate some of the corrupted manatite nearby...

丢下日志之后，我手头只剩这张纸了。
一个名字在空气中回荡：鲍莫努斯。
我在研习中见过这个名字，
但它本该只是个传说……罢了。
鲍莫努斯正伸来它的触手，腐蚀这里的法力晶石，
连同我一起。若有可能，我会试着关闭那道裂隙。
也许，
如果我能引爆附近一些被腐蚀的法力晶石……

For 600 years we have lived in Undralis, the undercity of Elok`ora. I leave this note, that the world to come (for I trust that mankind will endure) will know what was done here. We built a civilization, and have lived in relative peace. Although constrained to these caverns, we have toiled and chiseled a city for ourselves. Our lives have been good and full. Today that comes to an end, for the spawn of the dark lord is pouring forth from both above and below. The ground vomits forth vile creatures the likes of which we have never seen before. Above us, the goblins and trolls, once our allies, join his legions and rake the ground apart to find us. There will be no escape for us, yet we have long been acquainted with this ending. It was clear many years ago that this would be our fate. There is one more hope. Zakerunda has found something ancient...

六百年来，我们一直生活在翁德拉利斯，
埃洛克欧拉的地下城。我留下这张便笺，
愿未来的世界（我相信人类终
将延续）知晓这里发生过什么。我们建立起文明，
过着相对安宁的生活。虽然困守于这些洞穴，
我们仍辛勤开凿出了属于自己的城市。
我们的人生美好而充实。今天，
这一切走到了尽头，
黑暗领主的孽种正从地上地下同时涌出。
大地呕吐出我们前所未见的邪恶生物。
在我们上方，
曾是盟友的哥布林与巨魔加入了它的军团，
将地表翻得支离破碎来搜寻我们。我们无路可逃，
而这样的结局我们早已熟悉，
许多年前就清楚这会是我们的命运。
还剩最后一线希望。
扎克伦达找到了某样古老之物……

These halls have become a solemn place. We wait for the end, and know not when it will come. It would have been better to have stood and fought, even knowing death was coming. I pray that this choice we made will show its benefit one day, but as of now it has become unbearable. Our hope is that a way to victory will be found, and that our descendants will one day live in these lands again. That remains a distant hope, but our hope nonetheless. Zakerunda has left to seek something. If he fails, we will likely all perish.

这些厅堂已成肃穆之地。我们等待着终局，
却不知它何时到来。哪怕明知死亡将至，
当初挺身一战或许也更好。
我祈祷我们所做的这个选择有朝
一日能显露出它的价值，但时至今日，
它已变得令人难以忍受。
我们盼望能找到取胜之法，
盼望我们的后代有朝一日能重回家园。
这仍是遥远的希望，却终究是希望。
扎克伦达已动身去寻找某样东西。若他失败，
我们恐怕都将殒命。

I have tried to find a way across for what seems like days, and now my feet are caught in this accursed webbing. I can feel a draft, so there must be another entrance to this place. The treasures will be mine, but for now I must work at freeing myself. Then, I will leave this chamber, return to the world above and seek this other entrance.

我寻找通路似乎已有数日之久，
如今双脚又被这该死的蛛网缠住。
我能感觉到气流，这地方一定有另一个入口。
宝藏终将归我所有，
但当务之急是先把自己弄出来。之后，
我会离开这个房间，回到地上世界，
去寻找那个入口。

After all the trouble I went through there was another lock! My pick is too worn after the last one. I shall have to return later and claim the treasure. The others may ask why I returned empty handed. I will not endure their mockery. I should try again after some rest.

费了那么大力气，里面居然还有一道锁！
我那根撬锁针在上把锁之后已经磨损得太厉害了。
只好改日再来取宝藏。
其他人也许会问我为何空手而归。
我可不想遭他们嘲笑。休息一阵之后，
我再来试试。

We found Kalindraur, but these monsters continue to assault us. I have ventured into the halls to destroy them or at least keep them at bay until the doors can be sealed. I have shut the bridge behind me and set up a ward. The only other way is now through the library.


I left a chest hidden outside Kalindraur's southern door that will only open for whoever possesses this note. There is vital information in it. I can already feel my knowledge slipping away, now that I am outside. Enter from the Library, find this chest, and return the information to Naira.

我们找到了卡林德劳尔，
但那些怪物仍在不断袭击我们。我潜入厅堂，
要将它们消灭，或至少拖住它们，
直到各扇门被封死。我已断掉身后的桥，
并布下了结界。
如今唯一的其他通路要穿过图书馆。


我在卡林德劳尔南门外藏了一只箱子，
只有持有此条的人才能打开。
里面装着至关重要的信息。身在野外，
我已感觉到自己的知识正在流失。从图书馆进入，
找到那只箱子，把信息交给奈拉。

... I have done it! I finally narrowed the password down to three possible options; all words of power used in ancient times. I hope this spell will transcribe the magical words as well. The first, "@0" I believe to be the correct one. The others are "@1" and "@2". It should be uttered into the air as close as possible to the wall carvings in the stairwell. I must hurry, it is hunting for me even now.. oh no... it has found me... no... NOOO!!!!

……我成功了！我终于把密码缩小到三种可能，
都是上古时代使用过的力量之词。
我希望这道法术也能把魔法词转写下来。
第一个「@0」，我相信是正确的那个。
另外两个是「@1」和「@2」。
要在楼梯间的墙壁雕刻附近尽可能贴近地念出它。
我必须快一点，它现在就在猎捕我……哦不……
它找到我了……不……不……！！！！

The southern hall has been breached. We have nowhere to go, except deeper into the caves. The denizens of the deep have not yet emerged from the fungal regions or the eastern chambers, and we do not know why. We will flee in both directions and pray that some survive.

南厅已被攻破。我们无处可去，只能深入洞穴。
深处的居民尚未从菌类区域或东侧厅室中涌出，
我们也不知道原因。我们将向两个方向逃散，
祈祷有人能活下来。

We have retreated to the undercity district of Undralis. We no longer know what transpires above ground, but it is unlikely that anyone has survived on the entire surface of Springhold. The rest of the world... may Leunamar save them. Here we shall fortify. Praise be that our ancestors had the foresight to make this place as secure as it is. Though the creatures of darkness are many, I believe we can hold them back. One day we shall return to the world above and bring vengeance upon the evil that has devoured our world.

我们已退守翁德拉利斯的地下城区。
地上发生着什么，我们已无从得知，
但斯普林霍尔德的地表恐怕已无人幸存。
至于世界的其他地方……愿卢纳玛尔拯救他们。
我们将在此加固防御。庆幸的是，
我们的先祖有先见之明，把这里建得足够坚固。
黑暗生物虽多，我相信我们守得住。总有一天，
我们会重返地上世界，
向吞噬了我们世界的邪恶复仇。

I was promised a night I would never forget as an apology for the disrespect I was shown. One free night in the inn, fully catered. This is treachery! All I did was ransack some peasant's home. I cannot take it down here anymore! And to make matters worse, there is the horrible smelling red ooze slowly seeping in from a crack in the walls. Ghastly. I cannot wait to be let out so I can give that Gyffard a piece of my mind... and sword! And this letter shall be proof of my improper conditions!

他们答应给我一个终生难忘的夜晚，
作为对我所受轻慢的道歉，旅店免费住一晚，
吃喝全包。这是背信弃义！
我不过是洗劫了一户农民的家而已。
我在这下面再也待不下去了！更糟的是，
墙缝里正缓缓渗进来一种气味恶心的红色黏液。
真吓人。我巴不得赶紧被放出去，
好去教训那个吉法德一顿……用我的剑教训！
这封信就是我遭受不公待遇的证据！

By order of Festos Ingram, Mayor of Emerisk, this attached key is not to be used. The graveyard is becoming not only a home to dangerous animals, but much worse, in my opinion, a noise nuisance. I simply cannot sleep with all the wailing and howling. No more parties there, and no more entry!

奉埃梅里斯克市长费斯托斯·英格拉姆之命，
随附的这把钥匙禁止使用。
墓园如今不但成了危险动物的巢穴，
更糟的是（依我之见）还成了噪音之源。
又是哀嚎又是长啸，我根本睡不着。
那里再也不准聚会，再也不准进入！

I came all this way... all this way. And now I cannot cross. There are too many creatures lurking these halls. It is the end for me, but perhaps I can do some good as I face the end. Etched on the stone next to me is a symbol of the fae. I believe you need the aid of one to cross. How, I cannot say, but I am out of ideas. Maybe I should have investigated the old house before I came... I believe I shall lie down and rest. Yes. I shall rest, and never wake.

我一路走到这里……走了这么远。
如今却过不去了。这些厅堂里潜藏的怪物太多了。
对我来说，这就是终点了。但在面对终局之时，
也许我还能做点好事。
身旁的石头上刻着一个妖精的符号。我相信，
要过去必须得到妖精的帮助。具体如何，
我说不上来，但我已经再无办法。
也许我当初该先调查那栋老房子再来……
我想我该躺下歇一歇了。是的。我要休息了，
再也不要醒来。

For nearly seventy cycles we have persisted in these chambers. Andimus, in his madness, insisted some friend in the dark had kept us safe. He passed last cycle, and it is true that something has changed. Whatever safety we have enjoyed beneath the bleak halls of our former glory is coming to an end. It was never much of a life, sealed away in this place. It will now become our tombs. Something is coming closer, and we can do nothing to stop it. Its chittering screams rise from the caverns below. I am determined, even in my old age, to go down fighting.

我们在这片厅室中苦撑了近七十轮。
安迪姆斯疯疯癫癫地坚称，
黑暗中有位朋友庇佑着我们。他已于上一轮离世，
而确实有什么变了。
我们曾在昔日荣光的惨淡厅堂之下享有的庇护，
正走向尽头。封困于此的生活本就不算生活，
如今这里更将成为我们的坟墓。
有什么东西正越逼越近，而我们无能为力。
它尖细的嘶鸣从下方的洞窟中升起。纵然年迈，
我也决意战死到底。

If you are reading this then I did not survive, or am lost to these bleak halls. Know that Naira, chief librarian for Queen Elyscia of Arenquist, has extracted some of her memories and kept them in a safe place in case the shelter cannot protect her. She will need help retrieving them. The word "@5" should trigger her to remember where she kept them, and it should open the door to Kalindraur, right beside this chest. The magic will know friend or foe.

如果你读到了这封信，那么我多半已经殒命，
或迷失在了这些凄凉的厅堂中。你要知道，
阿伦奎斯特女王埃莉西亚的首席图书管理员奈拉，
曾抽取出自己的一部分记忆，存放在安全之处，
以防庇护所无法保护她。
她需要有人帮忙找回这些记忆。
念出「@5」这个词，应当能让她想起存放之处，
它也能打开卡林德劳尔的门，就在这只箱子旁边。
这魔法会自行分辨敌友。
